title: Is the MIND diet as good for your brain as people think? Researchers put it to the test
desc: Researchers analyzing 15,427 adults in Poland and the Czech Republic found that higher MIND diet adherence was not significantly associated with lower mortality or better overall cognition after accounting for socioeconomic and lifestyle factors. However, greater adherence remained associated with modestly better verbal fluency, suggesting a possible cognitive association that requires further investigation.
